samples.question: Follow the single navy thread from its gold square start, through three pale checkpoints, to the gold diamond, and note the four successive gaps. Do the same from each red, green, and blue square to its matching-color diamond. A candidate matches when all four gaps have the same relative short-to-long pattern as the gold reference, allowing the whole pattern to be uniformly scaled. Which square color marks the unique match? Answer red, green, or blue.
